answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to disengage while preserving energy by holding a level eastward extension and continuously accelerating, rather than turning back toward B0100; the active opponent remained northwest and its missiles stayed north or behind the eastbound aircraft, so this path reduced direct exposure without sacrificing speed.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to survive and extend away from the remaining opponent and missile pressure by sustaining a fast descending east-southeast escape with repeated hard turn commands; B0100 remained northwest, then expended its last missile on a southeast trajectory broadly aligned with A0200, while A0200 continued opening eastward offset.
